name: check based double attack
description: With material not already favorable, the side to move has mate in one or a checking move that also leaves an enemy non-pawn piece with more attackers than defenders.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'check based double attack'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'With material not already favorable, the side to move has mate in one or a checking move that also leaves an enemy non-pawn piece with more attackers than defenders.'
import chess

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    values = (0, 100, 300, 300, 500, 900, 0)
    own = sum(values[p.piece_type] for p in board.piece_map().values() if p.color == stm)
    their = sum(values[p.piece_type] for p in board.piece_map().values() if p.color == opp)
    if own - their > 200:
        return False
    skipped = (chess.PAWN, chess.KING)
    for move in board.legal_moves:
        if not board.gives_check(move):
            continue
        board.push(move)
        if board.is_checkmate():
            board.pop()
            return True
        hit = False
        for sq, piece in board.piece_map().items():
            if piece.color != opp or piece.piece_type in skipped:
                continue
            attackers = board.attackers(stm, sq)
            if attackers and len(attackers) > len(board.attackers(opp, sq)):
                hit = True
                break
        board.pop()
        if hit:
            return True
    return False
